modules.module_title: Receipt and purging of LPG cylinders

pcs.pc_description: receive empty cylinders from distributor or from authorized cylinders manufacturers/repairers
check for spurious/OMC cylinder and inform the supervisor or concern authority
inform shortage receipt of cylinder or cap to the supervisor or concern authority
send all the cylinders due for mandatory testing
carry out purging of all the newly received cylinders or cylinders received after mandatory testing/hot repair.
fill good and usable empty cylinders conforming to IS-13258 to the extent of the capacity of each such LPG cylinder
check for any Valve leak, Bung Leak, O-ring leak and Body leak as per prescribed procedure
cap and seal the all filled cylinders passing all the Quality Control (QC) tests
calibrate filling scales and Quality Control (QC) equipment regularly
send filled cylinder for storage/dispatch

modules.module_title: Storage of filled and empty LPG cylinders

pcs.pc_description: stack the filled cylinder at cylinders storage shed within the earmarked place as per the prescribed rules
stack all empty cylinders in capped condition with proper identification/segregation mark
maintain inventory of filled and empty cylinders
carry out cold repair of defective cylinders such as Pin leak, Bung leak, O-ring leak, Body leak, Bend Foot ring and/or Stay plate
dispatch good conditioned filled LPG cylinders as per the instruction of concerned authority
coordinate for loading/unloading of LPG filled/empty cylinders from trucks
prepare daily/weekly/monthly statement of dispatches of LPG filled cylinders
store scrap such as cylinders/regulators/valves with reason of rejection
dispose scrap, cylinder and crushing of valve as per the SOP
maintain safety and security at LPG bottling plant and LPG storage area
